name: tamaclaudchi
description: TamaClaudchi in Claude Code: a pane of pixel pets, one per session across every folder, hatted by model

autoOpen.title: Open the shelf at start
autoOpen.description: Open the TamaClaudchi pane by itself when a session starts on a wide terminal. Off: only /tama opens it.

alerts.title: Alert when a pet needs you
alerts.description: How a pet that starts to need you (a permission prompt) is announced: a toast in each of your other sessions plus one desktop notification, a toast only, or nothing.

alertOnDone.title: Also alert when a pet finishes
alertOnDone.description: Announce a pet that has finished its turn and waits for you, as well as one that needs approval.

pollSeconds.title: Poll every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the shelf is read, 2 to 60: at every poll while its pane is open or alerts are on, every fourth otherwise.

graveyardDays.title: Graveyard and spend window (days)
graveyardDays.description: How far back closed pets are kept on the graveyard and counted on the spend page, 1 to 30.

sadAfterMinutes.title: Sad after (minutes)
sadAfterMinutes.description: A running pet that has waited on you this long looks sad. 0: never.

diskWarnGb.title: Disk warning (GB)
diskWarnGb.description: Claude's disk use on this machine turns orange past this.

diskAlarmGb.title: Disk alarm (GB)
diskAlarmGb.description: Claude's disk use on this machine turns red past this.
